brief: Goldman Prime Services tracks an accelerating hedge fund de-grossing streak: 7 of the last 8 sessions, a pattern last seen in April 2026 and absent in 2025. October 22 was the 5th-largest de-grossing day of the year (-1.6 SD), driven entirely by long selling, the heaviest since September 2025, hitting North America, Europe and EM Asia, with China/Hong Kong sold hardest in Asia. 9 of 11 sectors de-grossed, led by Info Tech (heaviest net selling since September 2024, concentrated in semiconductors, driven by Fundamental L/S plus multis/quants) and Industrials (third-largest de-grossing day of the year, driven by multis/quants). Global AI basket names saw their largest net selling since July. Prime book gross leverage fell to 312.3% (79th percentile 1-year) and net leverage to 71.8% (3rd percentile). Performance deteriorated in parallel: for the first time since COVID, all three broad hedge fund strategies fell over 1% in a single day on October 22, with Fundamental L/S, TMT, Systematic L/S and Multi-Strats all posting multi-sigma losses, following a similar momentum-driven AI sell-off on October 15 that marked only the third 80bp+ three-strategy down day since COVID.
